create_PartialDependenceDisplay: create a PartialDependenceDisplay from an estimator to plot partial dependence curves for feature interpretation
plot_partial_dependence: plot partial dependence and individual conditional expectation curves for one or two-way feature interactions
plot_ice_lines: plot individual conditional expectation lines subsampled from model predictions for a single feature
plot_categorical_partial_dependence: plot partial dependence bar charts for categorical features or heatmaps for two categorical feature pairs
center_partial_dependence: center partial dependence and ICE lines at the origin of the y-axis for consistent comparison across plots
